data.summary: The `go` directory is a single-purpose scenario definition used by the `aio-config gen` tooling to provision the Go toolchain inside a container image. It pairs a metadata descriptor (`scenario.toml`, consumed by the generator to build the TUI version selector) with an idempotent Docker build fragment (`fragment.Dockerfile`) that installs Go through mise's `core:go` backend. Together they form one composable L3 language layer rather than application code.

file_insights.name: fragment.Dockerfile
file_insights.summary: Docker build fragment that installs the Go toolchain via mise's core:go backend and verifies go/gofmt availability in both login and non-login shells.
file_insights.source_summary: The file contains an ARG GO_VERSION templated by the scenario generator, a RUN step executing `mise use -g "go@${GO_VERSION}"`, a `mise ls go` listing for diagnostics, and two verification loops that check `go`/`gofmt` resolve via `command -v` in login and non-login bash, finishing with a `go version` printout.
file_insights.detailed_description: This file is the executable half of the `go` scenario: it declares a GO_VERSION build ARG substituted by the generator, then runs `mise use -g` to register Go globally. Because `mise use -g` performs read-modify-write on the shared mise config, the fragment is designed to be idempotent and order-independent when composed with other language fragments. Post-install assertions validate the toolchain from both login and non-login shells, ensuring PATH exposure survives typical container shell contexts.
responsibilities: Declare the parameterized Go version build argument
Install the Go toolchain through mise's core:go backend
Verify go and gofmt are on PATH in both login and non-login shells
Remain idempotent and composable with other mise tool fragments

file_insights.name: scenario.toml
file_insights.summary: Scenario metadata consumed by `aio-config gen` describing the Go language scenario, its category, installer, and selectable versions.
file_insights.source_summary: A TOML document defining id = "go", name = "Go", a Chinese description noting the mise core:go backend installing into /opt/mise/installs with go/gofmt included, category = "lang", installer = "mise", and a single [[versions]] entry labeling 1.23.4.
file_insights.detailed_description: This file is the declarative descriptor that the `aio-config gen` fragment resolver reads to know that a `go` scenario exists, that it belongs to the `lang` category, and that it is installed by mise. It supplies the human-facing name/description shown in the TUI and enumerates the versions offered in the dropdown, which the generator substitutes into fragment.Dockerfile's GO_VERSION ARG. Without it, the sibling Dockerfile fragment would never be selected or parameterized.
responsibilities: Identify the scenario with a stable id and display metadata
Classify the scenario (lang) and declare its installer (mise)
Enumerate selectable Go versions for the version dropdown
Provide the version values consumed when generating fragment.Dockerfile
